mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.hint: Horizontal reflects across the midline of the arch (11 ↔ 21…); vertical reflects from one arch to the other (11 ↔ 41…), or from one edge of the tooth to the other when the model has a single arch. Pieces snap back onto the enamel and never overlap.

inspector.label: Properties
inspector.multiHint: Drag a selected piece to move the whole group; Shift-click pieces to add or remove them.
inspector.rotationGroupHint: The group turns around its centre, as you see it on screen: the pieces travel with it. On the stage, the “Rotate” dial gives a free angle.
inspector.standoffHint: Lower it if the piece floats off your model; raise it if it sinks into the enamel.
inspector.layoutHint: Align horizontally: puts the centres of the pieces on one horizontal line (one per arch); they only move up or down. Align vertically: puts them exactly on one vertical line as you see it on screen, whatever their tooth and across both arches; they slide left or right without changing height. For a result true to the smile, align in the front view. Space evenly: spreads the pieces at regular intervals along the arch. Centre: brings each piece to the middle of its tooth. A piece whose spot is taken stays where it is.
inspector.positionHint: Drag the piece on the model to move it (with several pieces selected, the whole group follows), or right-click it for quick actions. Centre on the tooth brings it back to the middle of its tooth. Pieces can touch but never overlap.
inspector.toothEmpty: No jewellery here yet. Drag a piece from the library onto the model.
inspector.cameraHint: Double-click any tooth to focus the camera on it.
inspector.noOverlap: Pieces can touch, but never overlap — occupied spots are refused.
inspector.designEmpty: Nothing placed yet. Drag a piece from the library onto the arch — it snaps onto the surface and follows its curve.
inspector.colorHint: The colours the shop sells this shape in: changing the colour swaps the piece for that shop gem, keeping its place and, when it can, its size.
inspector.colorMixedShapes: Select pieces of the same shape to change their colour together.
inspector.colorNone: The shop offers no other colour for this shape.
inspector.sizeHint: The sizes (SS) the gem is sold in. The diameter in mm is approximate; for a shape, it is the length of its longest side.
inspector.sizeMixed: These pieces have no size in common.
inspector.unavailable: This gem is no longer sold: it stays in the design but can no longer be ordered.

tryOn.title: Try on a smile

closeUp.body: Bring the phone closer and hold it straight in front of you, at smile height: your teeth should fill a good part of the photo, not your whole face. A photo taken too far away, at an angle, too dark or blurred is turned down before the render and does not count towards your renders of the day.
